title: Nothing smells better than freshly burned incense
text:
Nothing smells better than freshly burned incense. [[VIDEOID:79607dea240ecd2c0ea969c9fba71483]] Nothing smells better than freshly burned incense. I have a stockpile of different types and love trying new scents.

I've never burned an incense like this so this was a new experience for me. While the scent was very strong and pleasant I noticed the coils crumbled very easily. I went through two before getting the ones in the videos to sit on the holder and light.

This set does come with a lot of coils which is a plus. As I stated before the scent is very strong. I had to put it out about 5 minutes into burning as it was a bit overwhelming. (I live in a large 3br condo for space reference)

I did not care for the holder as it was very flimsy and I felt as if I could break at any moment if bent more than once.

Overall I'm just not to impressed with this set. I wish I could like it but i just can't. If anything I hope my review shows how the product could be improved.

I was selected to review this item at a discount. My reviews are based on quality and preformance and are never manipulated or altered in any way.
